Question: Assalamvalaikum..... My name is Sania,i have done Engineering and i m in a need of a job due to some financial problems in my home,and have got a job in a Central bank of india as Manager in Information Technology platform, i want to know sir that can i join for that post,according to islam i have heard that working in bam=nks is considered as illegal so i m asking you this question... please reply to me as soon as possible. Answer ID: 20242 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 415/285/L=1431) Any bank job which involves helping in interest is unlawful. The holy Prophet ( صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ) has cursed those who take interest, pay interest, record it and bear witness to it. And it is not better for a Muslim lady to do job in mixed gathering where the doors of sins are always open. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
